project.title: Brawlfur
project.description: An anime-style 3D model made to test out curves for hair modeling, toon shading, and line art modifier for a 2D look.

project.title: Day 2 Objects
project.description: This is my output after following the Day 2 video of the YouTube series "Introduction to Blender Series - For Absolute Beginners" which focused on creating objects in Object Editing mode. Despite being a series made to be done daily, it was so difficult that it took me more than a week to accomplish which made me halt from following the series after finishing this project. If I have the time, I will complete the series once and for all.

project.title: Rinblast
project.description: A lowpoly chibi-style 3D model made to practice simple posing and lighting. She is my first original character I made into a 3D model.
